title: Depression Test
description: An early screening to recognize symptoms of depression and significant changes in your daily energy (based on the past week).

questions.cesd_1: I was bothered by things that don't usually bother me.
questions.cesd_2: I did not feel like eating; my appetite was poor.
questions.cesd_3: I felt I could not shake off this sadness, even with help from family or friends.
questions.cesd_4: I felt I was just as good as other people (I'm worthy).
questions.cesd_5: I had trouble keeping my mind on what I was doing.
questions.cesd_7: I felt that everything I did was an effort (very exhausting).
questions.cesd_8: I felt hopeful about the future.
questions.cesd_9: I thought my life had been a failure.
questions.cesd_10: I felt fearful or anxious about something unclear.
questions.cesd_11: My sleep was restless or very poor.
questions.cesd_15: People were unfriendly or avoided me.
questions.cesd_19: I felt that people around me disliked me.

results.description: No indication of clinical depression. Your emotions are stable and within a normal range.
There are signs of emotional stress weighing on your days.
You're carrying a very heavy emotional load. Please reach out to a professional psychologist as soon as you can.
